scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:client && npm run copy:client && npm run build:server
scripts.copy:client: rm -rf server/dist/static && mkdir -p server/dist/static && cp -R client/dist/* server/dist/static/
scripts.dev: npm --prefix server run dev & npm --prefix client run dev
